mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO contract_item (contract_id, contract_no, sku, product_id, product_name, specification, quantity, unit, unit_price, amount, delivery_date, warehouse_name, remark, cases_num, quantity_per_case, pic_url) VALUES
(#{it.contractId}, #{it.contractNo}, #{it.sku}, #{it.productId}, #{it.productName}, #{it.specification}, #{it.quantity}, #{it.unit}, #{it.unitPrice}, #{it.amount}, #{it.deliveryDate}, #{it.warehouseName}, #{it.remark}, #{it.casesNum}, #{it.quantityPerCase}, #{it.picUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT id, contract_id, contract_no, sku, product_id, product_name, specification, quantity, unit, unit_price, amount, delivery_date, warehouse_name, remark, cases_num, quantity_per_case, pic_url, create_time FROM contract_item WHERE contract_id = #{contractId} ORDER BY id

SELECT ci.sku, ci.pic_url FROM contract_item ci JOIN ( SELECT sku, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM contract_item WHERE pic_url IS NOT NULL AND pic_url != '' AND sku IN #{sku} GROUP BY sku ) latest ON ci.id = latest.max_id
mapper.update: UPDATE contract_item SET product_name = #{productName}, specification = #{specification}, quantity = #{quantity}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, amount = #{amount}, delivery_date = #{deliveryDate}, warehouse_name = #{warehouseName}, pic_url = #{picUrl}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE contract_item SET quantity = #{quantity}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, amount = #{amount} WHERE id = #{id} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contract c WHERE c.id = contract_item.contract_id AND c.status = 1 AND c.is_deleted = 0)
